justification: Inspected [byte-buddy-benchmark/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/benchmark/ClassByExtensionBenchmark.java] and [byte-buddy-benchmark/pom.xml]. The underlying benchmark method `benchmarkByteBuddyWithProxyAndReusedDelegatorWithTypePool()` is a single-purpose, thin routine that builds one Byte Buddy subclass and returns one instance; the requested `jmhTest` class is a generated JMH wrapper in the `net.bytebuddy.benchmark.jmh_generated` package, which the pom explicitly treats as generated/excluded infrastructure. I found no evidence in the repository that this generated wrapper itself has multiple responsibilities, large internal method groups, or separable concerns, so insufficient modularization is not supported.
